text: ポケモン　やしきは　けんきゅうの　ため　かがくしゃが　たまに　でいり　しとる　ようだ

structure.jp: ポケモン　やしきは
けんきゅうの　ため
かがくしゃが　たまに　でいり　しとる　ようだ
structure.en: scientists seem to go in and out now and then

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a statement means 'it seems', judging from what you see or know. でいり しとる ようだ = 'it seems they go in and out'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: しとる is an old-man, western-dialect way to say している, for something that keeps happening. でいり しとる = 'are going in and out'.

patterns.name: 〜のため
patterns.span: けんきゅうの　ため
patterns.explanation: の ため after a thing means 'for the sake of' it. けんきゅうの ため = 'for research'.
